tool.name: Feat2traj
tool.description: : Converts a .pt file (features) to a trajectory using cartesian indices and topology from the stats file.

param.name: input_results_npz_path
param.label: input NPZ file
param.help: Path to the input reconstructed results file (.npz), typically containing an 'xhat' array. Format: [input].npz

param.name: input_stats_pt_path
param.label: input PT file
param.help: Path to the input model statistics file (.pt) containing cartesian indices and optionally topology. Format: [input].pt

param.name: input_topology_path
param.label: input PDB file
param.help: Path to the topology file (PDB) used if no suitable topology is found in the stats file. Used if no topology is found in stats. Format: [input].pdb

param.name: outname_output_traj_path
param.label: output XTC,PDB,DCD name
param.help: Path to save the trajectory in xtc/pdb/dcd format Format: [output].[format]

param.name: outname_output_top_path
param.label: output PDB name
param.help: Path to save the output topology file (pdb). Used if trajectory format requires separate topology Format: [output].pdb

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax
